title: Rite bundle index (format 0)
description: The bundle.json index of an evidence bundle: what kind of bundle it is and which files it holds. It repeats no digest: every file other than the transcript is bound by a digest the transcript records, so a verifier checks the files against the transcript.

$schema.description: The URL of the JSON Schema this index was written against, for editors. A reader ignores it.

files.description: Every file in the bundle other than the index.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the bundle's transcript, for indexing. A verifier computes it from the transcript and compares.

oneOf.description: The complete record: the transcript with every fact, the ceremony definition if it was included, and the artifacts the run kept.
A disclosure derived from a complete bundle: every line above the threshold is withheld, and only the artifacts whose facts are disclosed are included. The ceremony definition is never included.

threshold.description: The widest level disclosed: every line at or below it is disclosed, every line above it withheld.

name.description: For an artifact, its name as declared in the ceremony.

path.description: The file's path from the bundle root, with `/` between components.

FileRole.description: What a file is, which also says what binds it to the transcript.

oneOf.description: The transcript, which the fingerprint identifies.
The ceremony definition, bound by the template digest on ceremony_started.
An artifact, bound by the digest on its artifact_written fact.

Level.description: The confidentiality level of a line: who may see its fact. Levels are integers ordered from the widest audience to the narrowest, so a disclosure up to a level withholds every line above it. Three levels are built in at fixed values: public (10, anyone), restricted (20, auditors under agreement) and confidential (30, the ceremony's own organisation). Every level a transcript uses is declared in its header.

Sha256Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.
